messages:
nora: New hire hit a nasty onboarding snag. Installed redwoodctl from our installer script and ran `redwoodctl localtest start --profile=onboard-2026` but the command picked up a profile named 'global-demo' and the tooling used demo credentials.

nora: Repro steps: run the install script, create ~/.config/redwood/profile with `name: onboard-2026`, then `redwoodctl config resolved --verbose` shows the wrong active profile.

ash: can you paste the resolved output?

nora: pasted: 
```
candidates:
 - /etc/redwood/profile -> name: global-demo
 - /home/nora/.config/redwood/profile -> name: onboard-2026
requested_profile: onboard-2026
selected: global-demo
```

ben: that's the precedence bug again. But this one looks different: the install script writes a profile into /etc/redwood/profile (not /etc/xdg) as part of a legacy quickstart flow. Our resolver is short-circuiting when it finds the system file.

ash: two quick fixes: (1) CLI should honor a requested profile name by scanning all candidate locations and preferring exact matches before applying path precedence; (2) installer should avoid dropping active example profiles into runtime lookup paths.

packaging: noted. The install script wrote `/etc/redwood/profile` to support an offline demo; legacy behavior. We'll change the installer to place examples under `/usr/share/redwood/examples` and remove the system profile on next release. Filed PKG-870.

nora: side-effect: because the demo profile contains a demo client_id, `redwoodctl login` opened a browser but the token never matched and login errored with `client_id mismatch`. So this isn't just a UI glitch, it breaks auth.

ben: add auth unit tests that simulate two profiles with the same name but different client_ids and verify login uses the expected profile when requested. Also add a warning when the resolver falls back to a system profile while an explicit requested profile exists.

ash: workaround for now: remove `/etc/redwood/profile` or run `REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH=$HOME/.config/redwood redwoodctl localtest start --profile=onboard-2026`. Also `redwoodctl login --client-id=<org-id> --profile=onboard-2026` works.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-1802 (resolver: prefer exact match when requested), PKG-870 (installer: move examples), and opened PR #1789 with tests and a resolver patch.

packaging: we'll also audit other installation channels (tarball, brew, windows installer) to ensure we don't place example profiles into active config paths. PKG-871 created for audit.

nora: added a short blurb to the onboarding checklist: "If localtest seems to use a demo profile after install, check /etc/redwood/profile and remove it or set REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH to your home config."

ben: I'll land the CLI fix that scans all candidate paths for requested_profile names and surface a clear error if the requested name exists only in unreadable or system-only locations.

ash: thanks all  happy onboarding is unblocked. :thumbsup:
